text:
maria-ops: :rotating_light: Heads up — detection flagged service-account key reuse across multiple projects starting ~03:12 UTC. External egress to an unfamiliar IP range. Could be exploited-in-the-wild. Link: https://logs.redwood.internal/trace/abc123

maria-ops: Affected SA looks like `svc-ingest-prod@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. Observed: listing buckets, pulling audit logs, and API calls to the KMS decrypt endpoint.

sam-security: Thanks — can you paste the raw event snippet?

maria-ops: ```
# redacted log
"actor": "svc-ingest-prod@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com",
"action": "decrypt",
"target": "projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/kr-1/cryptoKeys/ck-1",
"src_ip": "45.76.32.11"
```

sam-security: :eyes: That IP is in a cloud provider block we've seen in other compromises. Treat as active exploit.

sam-security: Immediate mitigation plan:
- Disable all user-managed keys for that service account
- Revoke any long-lived tokens and rotate KMS keys used by that SA
- Apply temporary deny-binding on any clusterrolebindings that reference this SA
- Turn on audit-logging retention for KMS & IAM to S3 for 90d (if not already)

ani-eng: I can run the RBAC sweep and list bindings. Running `kubectl get clusterrolebinding -o wide | grep svc-ingest-prod` and `gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=svc-ingest-prod@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com` now.

lee-oncall: I will revoke keys and disable tokens, then push a short-lived bootstrap key for services that absolutely need it. Planning commands:
```
gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable KEY_ID --iam-account=svc-ingest-prod@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com
kubectl delete clusterrolebinding ingest-prod-admin-binding
```

maria-ops: We should also snapshot affected KMS key versions and rotate asap. sam, any blockers on rotation?

sam-security: Rotation's fine but needs CA/ops coordination — encrypting services will fail until clients pick up the new key. We'll do staged rotation with fallback. Also: create deny policy in OPA to block KMS decrypts from external IPs until we confirm.

incident-bot: Incident created — INC-2026-453: svc-ingest-prod suspected key compromise. Pager duty: @lee-oncall.

cory-legal: If confirmed exploited-in-the-wild, we may need to notify affected customers depending on data scope. Please capture impacted projects and buckets.

jess-comm: Prep a short internal comm and a customer-facing blurb template (if required). I'll stand by for confirmation.

ani-eng: Sweep results: 3 clusterrolebindings referenced the SA (ingest-prod-admin-binding, metrics-reader-binding, legacy-deploy-binding). Found 2 user-managed keys: KEY_A, KEY_B. They were last used within the past hour.

lee-oncall: Disabled KEY_A and KEY_B. Removed ingest-prod-admin-binding. Limited legacy-deploy-binding to namespace scope.

sam-security: Good. Next steps:
1) Full KMS key rotation plan (sam + lee)
2) Re-issue least-privilege service accounts for impacted workloads (ani)
3) Forensic export of audit logs to immutable storage (maria)
4) Legal/comm sync (cory/jess)
5) Postmortem stub and timeline (sam)

ani-eng: I'll create new SA with short-lived keys and update helm charts to use Workload Identity where possible. PRs incoming.

maria-ops: Forensics: exporting 7 days of KMS/IAM logs to gs://ir-exports/inc-2026-453/ (write-only, access limited).

cory-legal: Please add a data index of affected buckets and whether objects were read, listed, or written. We need this for customer notice decision.

jess-comm: Drafted a customer-safe blurb: "We detected suspicious activity involving a service account in our infrastructure. We've isolated the account, rotated keys, and are continuing an investigation — no confirmed customer data exposure at this time. We'll update customers by EOD if we find anything." Feedback?

sam-security: Fine. Add a statement about steps taken to mitigate and contact for questions. Keep legal sign-off before sending.

lee-oncall: Monitoring: added firewall rule to block the offending IP range at perimeter and created temporary alert for any KMS decrypt operations from external IPs.

maria-ops: Quick asks for infra:
- Enable KMS audit logs export to BigQuery for faster queries (ticket created INFRA-927)
- Run RBAC linter across repos to find other SAs with broad cluster-admins (ticket INFRA-928)

ani-eng: Will open PRs to rotate usages and add Workload Identity where possible. ETA: 4 hours for initial PRs.

sam-security: I'll draft the postmortem template; include timeline, root cause, and remediation checklist (least privilege, key management, rotate long-lived creds, alerting improvements).

jess-comm: Ready to send internal comm once legal signs off.

cory-legal: Reviewing. Please lock down notes; we'll coordinate on disclosure timing.

sam-security: Thanks all. If anyone sees new activity, ping here and escalate to PagerDuty. We'll reconvene at +30 if no new events. :lock:

lee-oncall: +1. Continuing monitoring.
